name: Auto Create Item For CareService
script:
# 1) Auto-create/link Item from CareService
if not doc.item_code:
    service_name = (doc.service_name or "").strip()
    if not service_name:
        frappe.throw("Service name is required")

    # Reuse existing Item with same name (prevents duplicates)
    existing_item = frappe.db.get_value("Item", {"item_name": service_name}, "name")
    if existing_item:
        doc.item_code = existing_item
    else:
        # Use doc.name for safe item_code (always ASCII)
        base_token = (doc.name or "CARESERVICE").upper().replace("_", "-")
        base = ("VET-" + base_token)[:40]
        code = base
        i = 1
        while frappe.db.exists("Item", {"item_code": code}):
            i += 1
            code = f"{base}-{i}"

        # Pick an existing Item Group
        if frappe.db.exists("Item Group", "Veterinary Services"):
            item_group = "Veterinary Services"
        elif frappe.db.exists("Item Group", "Services"):
            item_group = "Services"
        else:
            frappe.throw("Create an Item Group named 'Services' (or 'Veterinary Services') first.")

        item = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "Item",
            "item_code": code,
            "item_name": service_name,   # Arabic OK
            "item_group": item_group,
            "stock_uom": "Nos",
            "is_stock_item": 0,
            "maintain_stock": 0,
            "is_sales_item": 1,
            "is_purchase_item": 0
        })
        item.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        doc.item_code = item.name

# 2) Upsert Item Price from default_price + price_list
if doc.default_price and doc.price_list:
    rate = float(doc.default_price)
    price_list = doc.price_list

    ip_name = frappe.db.get_value(
        "Item Price",
        {"item_code": doc.item_code, "price_list": price_list},
        "name"
    )

    if ip_name:
        frappe.db.set_value("Item Price", ip_name, "price_list_rate", rate)
    else:
        ip = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "Item Price",
            "item_code": doc.item_code,
            "price_list": price_list,
            "price_list_rate": rate
        })
        ip.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
